default.description: Main window capability. Only core:default is granted: the app talks to the backend through its own commands (boot_status / api / restart_sidecar), never through core plugins. core:default is what lets the front end subscribe to the boot-status event; without it, event.listen is denied with 'core:event:allow-listen' (observed 2026-10-29 — the window sat on the boot screen forever).
